The [[Antiquated Staff]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] obtained from the [[Dragrimmar Chest]], which spawns  after killing the [[Remnant of Antiquities]] in the [[Sepulchre of Dragrimmar]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +15
:[[Cold damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Water Magic]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[spell]]s (20% chance)
:Halves casting time of [[Water Magic]] [[spell]]s (20% chance)
:[[Health]] +30
